title: cairn test --exec refuses the flags it cannot honour
intention: cairn/devices/tester/cli.py refuses, exit 2 with a message naming each flag, any --exec invocation that also carries --seal, --netns, --hollow, --reseal or a proof path, before running anything.
why: Akien 2026-10-10: "to the best of your ability, get it all closed", pre-approved through PROVED. This ticket closes live trouble /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/troubles/cairn-test---exec-silently-drops---seal-and---netns.json, a measured fault that enters as a bug (skills/intent/SKILL.md: a bug enters as a ticket, not through /intent). Measured 2026-10-10: `cairn test --netns --seal --exec "<python> .../test_a_fixme_answer_binds_to_its_kick_back.py"` exited 0 and persisted no VALIDATION: cli.py:455 returns run_exec before --seal/--netns are read.
traces_to: Law 7 (a seal the caller asked for never silently becomes a no-op); Law 8.
how: cairn/devices/tester/cli.py main, just above `if args.exec_command is not None:` (:454): collect the incompatible flags set on args; if any, print 'cairn test --exec runs a command and mints no validation; it cannot honour: <flags>. Run the proof path without --exec to seal.' to stderr and return 2.
falsifier: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_exec_refuses_what_it_cannot_honour.py under PROVES {'d181339da3c3': {'1','2'}}: (1) cli main(['--seal','--exec','true']) and (['--netns','--exec','true']) each return 2 naming the flag and run nothing (a marker file the command would touch is absent); (2) main(['--exec','true']) returns 0. Hollow: removing the check reds 1.

decisions.text: Refuse rather than honour: run_exec mints no record by design (2c9eeab2da87). CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

In cli.main, right after args = ap.parse_args(folded) and above `if args.exec_command is not None:`, when args.exec_command is not None build bad = [f for f, on in (('--seal', args.seal), ('--netns', args.netns), ('--hollow', args.hollow), ('--reseal', args.reseal)) if on] + list(args.targets); if bad, print 'cairn test --exec runs a command and mints no validation; it cannot honour: ' + ', '.join(bad) + '. Run the proof path without --exec to seal.' to sys.stderr and return 2. A proof path is named as typed (each target verbatim). --timeout stays honoured; no other flag is checked. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

The proof is already written red-first: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_exec_refuses_what_it_cannot_honour.py, PROVES {'d181339da3c3': {'1','2'}}; it runs cli.main in a child python with '--exec', 'touch <scratch marker>' plus each of --seal, --netns, --hollow d181339da3c3, --reseal and the fixture path cairn/devices/tester/proofs/fixtures/green_proof.py, asserting exit 2, the flag named in stderr and the marker absent; tooth 2 runs --exec alone and asserts exit 0 and the marker present. Measured 2026-10-11: tooth 1 red, tooth 2 green. The build edits only cli.py. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
